title: What If You Were Born With Infinite IQ?
description:
You're born with infinite IQ… but you can't even hold up your own head.

You learn faster than anyone alive. You solve problems adults can't. Then one photo exposes your secret—and suddenly, powerful people want control of the smartest mind on Earth.

Would you reveal your intelligence or hide it? 👇

Subscribe to What If Effect for animated stories that turn impossible powers into unexpected problems.

#WhatIf #Animation #InfiniteIQ #whatifeffect #story #animatedstory #whatifanimation

comments.text: Be honest, if you had infinite IQ, would you share your discoveries openly like this, or keep them hidden to protect yourself? Curious to see where everyone lands on this.
I really love the ending, where the two kids are playing. It’s so cinematic.
My friend Adam always says he has the highest IQ in our group, but yesterday he spent 5 minutes pushing a door that clearly said PULL, so I guess his infinite IQ is still loading  ❤
Tiktok already has that video copied
The ending hit harder than I expected — infinite IQ, and the one question it can't answer is "are you happy?" Really well told.
“Infinite intelligence could answer almost any question, except the ones you can only answer by living” ~What if effect
Milo single-handedly outsmarted an infinite IQ brain just by making up completely nonsensical rules on the spot. You can't predict someone who doesn't even know what they're doing next.

Imagine understanding everything around you but still struggling to connect with people. This makes you wonder if having infinite intelligence would actually make life better or just more complicated. Such a fascinating thought experiment!
Honestly this a better version of this concept as 😅they didn't make the individual socially inept as much
The only thing this video needs to be complete is a high-energy house beat dropping the exact second he solves his first equation.

Milo was my favorite part — the one person whose rules kept changing so an infinite IQ still could not predict him. And the spoon experiment working out gravity as a baby, then his mom asking 'Are you happy?' and him having no answer, landed really well.
So basically Dr. Stone but no petrification
An incredible story with a powerful message! It reminds us that true happiness isn’t about being the smartest person in the world, but about friendship, freedom, and living a meaningful life. ❤
